critical_code_review_comments: live_rates.py — Clean module design: 4 independent async scrapers behind a small router (_SCRAPERS map), APScheduler AsyncIOScheduler with max_instances=1 + coalesce=True + misfire_grace_time=45s prevents job pileups, next_run_time=+3s ensures first fetch fires shortly after startup. _run_one() catches all exceptions and keeps prior rates payload while flagging ok=false — good resilience. build_response() always returns all 4 SOURCES via setdefault placeholder for the no_data_yet case.

live_rates.py:88-123 (scrape_sln_bullion) — uses GoodReturns as canonical source because the actual SLN Bullion homepage is auth-gated; the comment explicitly documents this substitution. Rates parsed via regex per karat + auto-computed per-10g. Silver extracted separately. If any regex misses (upstream markup change), function returns None and the module gracefully retains the last-good doc.

live_rates.py:127-180 (scrape_intergold_th) — Primary JSON mirror (chnwt.dev) with HTML fallback to goldtraders.or.th. Good defensive coding; both paths return same schema. Only concern: chnwt.dev is a community mirror — if it disappears the fallback HTML regex will kick in but might miss Thai character prefix.

live_rates.py:388-397 — Scheduler args=[db] captures the async motor client at startup; no per-request DB churn. Verified live: all 4 fetched_at timestamps advanced within a 65s window during the pytest run.

invoice/new.tsx:168-189 + 620-667 — Alert.alert with buttons replaced by custom <Modal> as instructed. Modal uses transparent+fade animation, Pressable backdrop for tap-to-dismiss, inner Pressable with stopPropagation to prevent bubbling. Both button paths (Wapas Jao → setShowFormalConfirm(false), Haan Save Karo → setShowFormalConfirm(false); doSave()) verified end-to-end on web preview. Formal-only gating (formMode === 'formal') preserves Informal fast-save path.

bullion.tsx:388-540 — LiveRatesResponse type + 60s polling via useEffect + setInterval + apiGet('/api/live-rates'); LiveRateCard component memoises timeAgo string on fetchedAt change. Freshness pill correctly toggles between green (Ns ago / Nm ago) when !is_stale and orange STALE when is_stale — verified live.
server.py:5599-5614 — _startup_live_rates_scheduler wraps start_scheduler(db) in try/except to prevent boot failures if APScheduler ever misbehaves. Shutdown handler cleanly calls stop_scheduler().
